opportunities.name: End-to-end city trip research and summary note
opportunities.description: For a given destination city and date range, search Paris→{city} flights on Google Flights, a hotel on Booking.com, a top tour on Viator, then save a one-line trip summary to the Notes app.
opportunities.site: google.com/travel/flights, booking.com, viator.com, local Notes app
steps: On Google Flights, keep origin Paris, set destination to {city}, pick departure and return dates, click Search, note the best/cheapest flight and price
On Booking.com, enter {city}, select check-in/check-out dates, click Search, note the top hotel and its total price
On Viator, search '{landmark} tour {city}', skip dates, open the first result, note its title and price
In Notes, add 'Trip {city} {dates}: flight {airline} {price}, hotel {hotel} {price}, {tour} {price}'

instances.values: Lisbon, Nov 12–16 (flights only; the results page errored)
Rome, Dec 3–7; easyJet €89, Room Roma Nazionale €452, Colosseum tour €54
Barcelona, Jan 20–24; Vueling/Iberia €113, IBIS Budget €543, Sagrada Familia tour €54

opportunities.name: Browser-support lookup and email reply
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse.com and MDN, then write an email to a colleague saying which version of a given browser first supports it, with the MDN docs link.
opportunities.site: caniuse.com, developer.mozilla.org, local mail compose page
steps: On caniuse.com, type the {feature} into the 'Can I use' box and read the {browser} support row
On MDN, click Search, type the {feature}, open the matching reference page and copy its URL
Open New message, set To to {recipient}
Set Subject to 'Re: {feature} in {browser}'
Write the body 'Hi {name}, {feature} is supported in {browser} from version {version}. Docs: {mdn_url}'
Send or discard the message

instances.values: CSS container queries (only the caniuse lookup was seen)

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison note
opportunities.description: Compare two Python packages by opening each one's PyPI page and source repository to collect version, release date, GitHub stars and license, then save a comparison note.
steps: On PyPI, search {package_a} and open the exact-match result
Record the version and release date, then click Repository/Source and record the stars and license
Repeat for {package_b}
In Notes, add '{a} {ver} {date} {stars} {license} vs {b} {ver} {date} {stars} {license}'

opportunities.name: Google Flights round-trip search
opportunities.description: Search Google Flights for a round trip from Paris to a destination on given dates and read the top results.
steps: Click the destination field and type {destination}
Select the city suggestion
Open the departure date picker and pick {depart_date}, then {return_date}
Click Done, then Search (click Reload if an error appears)
Read the best and cheapest flights and their prices

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com stays for a destination and date range and note the top property and its price.
steps: Dismiss the cookie/Genius popups if shown
Type {city} in the destination field and select the city suggestion
Open the calendar, pick {checkin} and {checkout}
Click Search and read the top result's name and price

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20–24 → €543 (Vienna was typed first; it started at about 1092 and was interrupted)

opportunities.name: Viator tour search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for a tour query and record the first result's title and price.
steps: Reject cookies if prompted
Type {query} in 'Where to?' or the top search bar
Choose 'Search for {query}' and skip dates
Open or read the first result card's title and price
